### Fixed
- **Three of the scopes we told you to enable do not exist.** The token guide
  listed read scopes for tasks, notes and calls that HubSpot shows no toggle for,
  in any menu, on any tier. Anyone setting up a new portal was sent hunting for
  checkboxes that were never there. Those reads are granted implicitly and have
  always worked; the guide now lists only the 15 scopes you can actually tick,
  and says so explicitly. If a report ever warns that tasks or notes were not
  measured, it now tells you to reissue the Service Key instead of pointing at a
  scope you cannot grant. On a first run the guide also opens by itself rather
  than hiding behind a fold, since that is the one moment someone needs it.

### Added
- **A proper Service Key guide, shipped with every release.** `SERVICE_KEY.md`
  covers where the key lives (and the two credentials it is easy to confuse it
  with), what each scope is read for so you can answer a client's security
  questions, what a client loses by withholding one, and what the three kinds of
  `403` actually mean: a missing scope, a stale key that needs reissuing, or a
  Professional portal correctly refusing an Enterprise-only endpoint. The quick
  start now carries the full scope list too, instead of pointing vaguely at "the
  read scopes HubScan needs".
